description: This file defines a class ADODB2_sqlite for handling SQLite database operations within the ADOdb PHP library, including type mapping and SQL statement generation.

classes.name: ADODB2_sqlite
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict to provide SQLite-specific database abstraction functionalities.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps custom meta types to SQLite data types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for altering columns, not natively supported by SQLite.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for dropping columns, not natively supported by SQLite.

methods.name: RenameColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for renaming columns, not natively supported by SQLite.
